issue.title: Add Upload/Download over Cellular Toggle to Settings and Sync Page
issue.body: Fluent translators frequently work in areas where cellular data is limited or expensive. By default, Fluent should not use cellular data for uploads or downloads — but users who choose to allow it should be able to opt in. This ticket adds an off-by-default "Upload/Download over cellular" toggle to the Settings menu as the canonical location, and surfaces the same setting on the Sync page for convenience. ## Functional Requirements ### Settings Menu — Upload/Download over Cellular - Add a toggle row to the Settings menu below the Prepare for Offline setting with the label "Upload/Download over cellular" and the description "Use mobile data to upload recordings when WiFi isn't available." - The toggle is off by default. - When off, uploads and downloads only initiate or continue over WiFi; if WiFi is lost while either is active, pause automatically. - When on, uploads and downloads proceed over any available connection. ### Sync Page — Upload/Download over Cellular - Display the same toggle row on the Sync page, below the Sync Now / Pause / Cancel buttons and above the download queue progress section. - Use the same label and description text as the Settings instance. - This control mirrors the Settings toggle — changing either one updates the other immediately. > **Note:** Both controls represent the same underlying setting. They must stay in sync — changing the value on the Sync page is reflected in Settings and vice versa. > **Note:** #40 (now closed) included an upload-only cellular toggle in the Settings page. This ticket extends that to cover downloads as well and adds a mirrored toggle on the Sync page. A partial implementation may already exist — scope here extends it.

comments.body:
### Ticket-level AC waivers (explicit)

For [#200](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/200), the following #146 acceptance criteria are **waived on this issue** with linked follow-ups (per `AGENTS.md` — not PR-body-only notes):

1. **Pause in-flight upload/sync work when WiFi is lost while the cellular toggle is off**  
   Current PR gates Sync Now and flips Sync page mock status to `paused`. Real pause/cancel of an in-flight upload/sync engine is deferred to **#150** (upload trigger / sync engine).

2. **Downloads honor the cellular toggle**  
   No download worker exists on `main` yet. Gating downloads is deferred to **#201** (Prepare for Offline download queue / inventory) and related download UI tickets (#52 / #147 as they consume the queue).

**Still in scope for #146 / #200:** Settings toggle (already on `main`), mirrored Sync page toggle via shared preferences, WiFi detection, Sync Now / status chrome respecting the preference.
